# External vehicle-reference history

Build 1.2 renders the actual original VehicleView models in the garage. No photographs, other vehicles or scenery objects are displayed behind them. Paint selections are shared with the driving model.

The following external photographs were researched as visual references and displayed in build 1.1. Their JPEG files have been removed from the application; the source URLs, historical checksums and license metadata below document that earlier reference history. The photographs are not OEM CAD or exact configuration references.
